name: Ring of Spell Inversion
body:
Aura strong abjuration; CL 13th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a ring of spell turning. However, any spell the wearer casts which targets another person is directed back at himself.

This ring can be removed by casting remove curse followed by a successful dispel magic upon it. Doing so renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of spell turning

Identification DC 38
False Identification DC 28
